source: Latest user-supplied T2 CSV; user declares sea-level ISA and no further convergence after supplied endpoint.
kinematic_viscosity_basis: Sea-level ISA nominal value, not independently present in CSV or a new settings screenshot.
cl_max_basis: User-selected model limit from last supplied converged point. Numerical nonconvergence is not proof of aerodynamic stall. Supersedes previous user limit 0.9.
control_mode: fixed_elevator per user workflow; numerical elevator angle not yet supplied
trim_drag_policy: No extra trim correction; retain total exported CD.
point_retention_policy: All 55 points active; Mach>0.65 warning only.
validity_notes: CL and Mach/Re vary together in T2; this is a reference CL-CD model, not an independently sampled Mach/Re map.
Source nonconvergence beyond the endpoint is user-reported; solver logs and unconverged points are not included.
Old altitude/cold polar is retained separately and is not relabelled as sea level.
